title: Dilapidated buildings.
content: When I dream of mall world, I sometimes leave the mall. I see a lot of run down buildings that are beyond repair on the street. They’re usually 5 story tall brownstones and the idea of going in them terrifies me. They’re going to cave at any moment. I also see a lot of people walking around too. Just wondered if anyone else had this experience and what it could possibly mean.
